method.code: Parse runtime pab_*.py ASTs; locate exact full-name string literal in live root kernel/layer/bridge/frozen runtime (exclude comments, docstrings, static generator and frozen snapshot copies). Record stage-specific mapping/dispatch or imported constant definition as code evidence; a literal name in a table is not by itself proof every ability works.
method.tests: Source-text substring grep over tests/test_*.py only (full registry card name); this can undercount alias-based tests.
method.priority: UNDERCLAIM when a not_modeled ability is implemented and behavior-tested; OVERCLAIM only for a contradicted modeled claim, not merely an honest PARTIAL unmodeled list; remaining verdict from code/test evidence presence.
method.limitations: Structural evidence not an exhaustive behavioral/rules proof; frozen event fixtures and physical bridge may differ; no live Oracle/CR cross-check; no kernel changes or registry certification.
